# Transcript Ingestion

> Preserves, normalizes, identifies, and indexes consulting transcripts as governed Knowledge Hub sources.

**What it does.** Preserve, normalize, identify, and index a consulting meeting transcript for a confirmed client opportunity or engagement.

**Use it when.** A transcript, call recording export, meeting notes file, VTT, or plain-text conversation must enter the Knowledge Hub.

**Not for.** Do not use for call preparation, general meeting summarization, or unsupported promotion of an AI summary into canonical truth.
